definition: Raw administrative physician stock at baseline t0=2020
mathematical_role: Initial condition for stock-flow conservation equation
source: INS Stat 123 (SRC_INS_STAT123)
justification: Directly observed official INS headcount for 2020. No estimation involved.

definition: Raw public-sector physician stock at t0=2020
mathematical_role: IPF marginal constraint for sector dimension
source: INS Stat 123 (SRC_INS_STAT123)
justification: Directly observed official INS public-sector headcount for 2020.

definition: Raw private-sector physician stock at t0=2020
mathematical_role: IPF marginal constraint for sector dimension
source: INS Stat 123 (SRC_INS_STAT123)
justification: Directly observed official INS private-sector headcount for 2020.

definition: Active Practice Ratio: proportion of INS-registered physicians who are actively practicing domestically
mathematical_role: Baseline stock filter at t0 only: N_active_0 = alpha * N_raw_0
source: Cross-reference INS stock vs CNOM active licensure rolls; triangulation with Carte Sanitaire staffing counts
justification: INS registrations include unpurged emigrated and inactive physicians. Ratio estimated by comparing INS totals with CNOM active registrations and Carte Sanitaire staffing. Applied at t0 only; NOT re-applied annually.

definition: Intention-to-Action Realization Factor: fraction of physicians expressing emigration intention who physically emigrate within a year
mathematical_role: Scales latent intention probability to realized emigration: P(Emigration) = kappa * logit^-1(DeltaV)
source: Docquier et al. (2014) DOI:10.1111/imre.12119; Clemens & Mendola (2020) DOI:10.1016/j.jdeveco.2020.102580
justification: No Tunisian-specific realization study exists. International evidence converges on 30-35% realization within 3-5 years. Bounds [0.25, 0.45] span the range of published estimates. This is the single most influential behavioral parameter and is prioritized in PSA.

definition: Administrative Clearance Multiplier: fraction of CNOM Good Standing certificate requests that result in realized border departure
mathematical_role: Observation equation: Observed_CNOM_t = (1/lambda_exit) * Realized_Flow_t
source: Cross-validation of CNOM certificate counts against French DREES/RPPS and German BAK intake registries for Tunisian-trained physicians
justification: Estimated by comparing cumulative CNOM certificates issued with cumulative Tunisian physician registrations appearing in French RPPS and German BAK databases. Some certificates are requested but never used (personal insurance, travel); some physicians emigrate without requesting certificates.

definition: Baseline intention-to-emigrate prevalence among young Tunisian physicians
mathematical_role: Denominates OR-to-RR conversion via Zhang & Yu (1998); anchors logit baseline in utility index
justification: Direct Tunisian survey. 68.6% of young physicians reported concrete emigration projects. Used as p0 in Zhang & Yu formula for this subpopulation. This is an ASSOCIATIONAL prevalence, not a causal emigration rate.

definition: Baseline intention-to-emigrate prevalence among medical residents
mathematical_role: Denominates OR-to-RR conversion; anchors resident-stratum logit baseline
justification: Direct Tunisian national survey across all 4 faculties. 75.6% expressed emigration intention. ASSOCIATIONAL prevalence only.

definition: Cross-sectional odds ratio: dissatisfaction with remuneration vs intention to emigrate
mathematical_role: Input to Zhang & Yu conversion; informs relative magnitude of salary factor vs other determinants
justification: Tunisian survey-derived ASSOCIATIONAL odds ratio. NOT a causal elasticity. Must be converted to RR via Zhang & Yu (1998) before use. At p0=0.686: RR = 2.14 / ((1-0.686)+(0.686*2.14)) = 1.31.

definition: Cross-sectional odds ratio: poor hospital working conditions vs intention to emigrate
mathematical_role: Input to Zhang & Yu conversion; informs relative magnitude of infrastructure factor
justification: Tunisian survey-derived ASSOCIATIONAL odds ratio. NOT a causal effect. At p0=0.686: RR = 2.48 / ((1-0.686)+(0.686*2.48)) = 1.35.

definition: Cross-sectional odds ratio: workplace violence exposure vs intention to emigrate among residents
mathematical_role: Input to Zhang & Yu conversion; informs security/safety factor magnitude
justification: Tunisian national survey-derived ASSOCIATIONAL odds ratio. At p0=0.756: RR = 2.06 / ((1-0.756)+(0.756*2.06)) = 1.14.

definition: Cross-sectional odds ratio: dissatisfaction with training supervision vs intention to emigrate
mathematical_role: Input to Zhang & Yu conversion; informs training/career factor magnitude
justification: Tunisian national survey-derived ASSOCIATIONAL odds ratio. At p0=0.756: RR = 1.89 / ((1-0.756)+(0.756*1.89)) = 1.12.

definition: Standardized relative utility weight for salary/income increase in DCE job choice
mathematical_role: Fixes relative importance of wage attribute in utility index DeltaV; anchors Class C choice weights
source: Mandeville et al. (2014) DOI:10.1016/j.socscimed.2014.06.019
justification: Pooled LMIC DCE meta-analytic estimate. No Tunisia-specific DCE exists. These are STATED PREFERENCE weights from hypothetical choice experiments, not revealed preference. Used as fixed relative anchors; absolute scale calibrated via beta_0.

definition: Standardized relative utility weight for infrastructure/equipment quality improvements
mathematical_role: Fixes relative importance of infrastructure attribute in utility index DeltaV
source: Mandeville et al. (2014) DOI:10.1016/j.socscimed.2014.06.019
justification: Same meta-analysis. Infrastructure improvements yield utility equivalent to 20-30% salary increase in LMIC health worker DCEs.

definition: Standardized relative utility weight for rural/hardship allowance package
mathematical_role: Fixes relative importance of rural incentive attribute in utility index DeltaV
source: Mandeville et al. (2014) DOI:10.1016/j.socscimed.2014.06.019
justification: Same meta-analysis. Rural hardship allowances with housing subsidies significantly improve remote post acceptance.

definition: Global baseline migration scale parameter
mathematical_role: Intercept of utility index DeltaV calibrated to match historical Tunisian macro series 2015-2021
source: Calibrated against INS stock + CNOM flow series (2015-2021)
justification: Free calibration parameter. Estimated by minimizing weighted squared loss between simulated and observed: (1) total active stock, (2) public stock, (3) private stock, (4) realized CNOM departure flows. Value determined during model implementation phase.

definition: Post-2021 structural regime shift in migration propensity
mathematical_role: Additive shift to beta_0 capturing the post-2021 acceleration in emigration: DeltaV_post2021 = beta_0 + delta_beta_2021
source: Calibrated against 2022-2024 observed departure acceleration in CNOM series and INS stock changes
justification: Free calibration parameter capturing the documented post-2021 emigration acceleration. Validated against 2022-2024 held-out data. Value determined during model implementation phase.

definition: Annual graduate inflow entering active domestic practice
mathematical_role: Positive inflow term in stock-flow conservation equation
source: MESRS / JORT (SRC_MESRS_JORT) residency quotas and thesis completion records
justification: National aggregate graduate output estimated from JORT residency quotas * ~92% completion rate. Historical range: 790 (2018-19) to 990 (2024-25). Future projections conditioned on 2025 announced 30% intake expansion.

definition: Fraction of residency entrants who complete training and enter active practice
mathematical_role: Transforms residency quota into realized graduate flow: G_t = quota_t * completion_rate
source: Historical thesis validation records from Tunisian medical faculties
justification: Estimated from historical ratio of completed theses to residency positions opened. Not formally published as a single statistic; derived from faculty-level thesis records.

definition: Annual retirement/permanent exit rate from Senior (55+) career stage
mathematical_role: Negative outflow term in stock-flow conservation for senior stratum
source: Tunisian civil service statutory retirement age (62-65 yrs) from Caisse Nationale de Retraite et de Prévoyance Sociale (CNRPS)
justification: Statutory retirement ages fixed by Tunisian civil service law. Exact age-specific annual retirement hazard not published in open data; structural rate calibrated to produce stock-consistent senior attrition. Tested across [0.015, 0.035] in PSA.

definition: Annual in-service mortality rate across active physician population
mathematical_role: Small negative outflow term in stock-flow conservation
source: WHO life tables for Tunisia; INS mortality statistics
justification: Age-standardized in-service mortality derived from INS/WHO Tunisian life tables for the 25-75 age band. Negligible relative to emigration and retirement flows.

definition: Annual return migration rate among cumulative expatriate stock
mathematical_role: Positive inflow term in stock-flow conservation: Returns_t = r_return * Cumulative_Expatriates_t
source: No Tunisian or North African empirical estimate exists. International literature suggests 1-5% annual return rates for skilled diaspora.
justification: GENUINELY UNOBSERVED. No Tunisian administrative registry tracks returning physicians. Rate is bounded structurally at [1%, 3%] as a conservative prior and subjected to wide-range PSA. This is flagged as a critical data gap in DATA_GAPS.md.

definition: Annual transition rate from public sector to private sector practice
mathematical_role: Internal reallocation term in sector dimension of state tensor
source: Implied by observed INS public/private stock trajectories (declining public, growing private 2017-2024)
justification: No direct Tunisian administrative record of public-to-private transitions exists. Rate implicitly constrained by requiring simulated public and private stocks to reproduce observed INS trajectories during calibration. Bounded [2%, 6%] for PSA.

definition: Annual transition rate from private sector to public sector practice
mathematical_role: Internal reallocation term in sector dimension of state tensor (reverse flow)
source: Implied by observed INS stock trajectories; assumed structurally smaller than r_pub_to_priv
justification: Private-to-public transitions are rare in Tunisia (lower salary, heavier administrative burden). Assumed at 20-30% of the reverse rate. No direct administrative record. Bounded [0.5%, 2%] for PSA.

definition: Annual transition rate from coastal/metro to interior/underserved
mathematical_role: Internal reallocation term in geography dimension
source: Carte Sanitaire regional public physician counts; implied by geographic distribution stability
justification: No direct administrative record of geographic moves. Constrained by requirement that simulated regional stocks match Carte Sanitaire regional headcounts at baseline. Rare voluntary movement toward interior. Bounded conservatively.

definition: Annual transition rate from interior/underserved to coastal/metro
mathematical_role: Internal reallocation term in geography dimension (reverse flow)
source: Carte Sanitaire data; documented coastal pull; guaranteed CHU transfer mechanisms
justification: Interior-to-coastal movement is well-documented as the dominant internal geographic mobility direction. Rate constrained by observed regional stock changes. Bounded [2%, 6%] for PSA.

definition: Annual social discount rate for economic evaluation
mathematical_role: Discounts future costs and physician-years to present value
source: Sanders et al. (2016) DOI:10.1001/jama.2016.12195 (2nd Panel on Cost-Effectiveness in Health and Medicine)
justification: International standard. Base case 3.0% per 2nd Panel recommendations. Tested at 0%, 5%, 8% in deterministic sensitivity analysis.

definition: Fraction of gross educational expenditure offset by the clinical service value of resident labor during training
mathematical_role: Reduces gross training cost to net training cost: Net = Gross * (1 - offset)
source: Human capital accounting literature; no Tunisian-specific study quantifying resident clinical service value
justification: Residents provide substantial frontline clinical service (emergency, ward coverage, on-call) at below-market wages. The 40% offset is a conservative structural assumption. No Tunisian empirical quantification exists. Tested across [30%, 50%] in PSA.

definition: Proportional public-sector base wage increase under Scenario 1
mathematical_role: Policy lever: shifts public-sector wage component of utility index; drives inframarginal cost calculation
source: Policy scenario assumption; informed by Tunisian physician union salary reform proposals
justification: Scenario assumption. +30% base wage increase reflects documented physician union demands. Lower bound (+20%) represents partial reform; upper (+40%) represents ambitious reform. Not an empirical estimate of intervention effect.

definition: Relative Risk of emigration under Scenario 1 salary reform vs status quo
mathematical_role: Multiplicative modifier to emigration probability under policy counterfactual
source: Derived from: (1) beta_wage_relative DCE weight, (2) magnitude of delta_w_scen1, (3) Zhang & Yu-corrected Tunisian survey ORs
study_design: Derived from DCE meta-analysis + survey OR bounds
justification: NOT directly observed. Must be derived during model implementation by combining DCE relative weights with policy scenario magnitude. The derivation chain is: DCE meta-weight -> scaled by policy magnitude -> bounded by Zhang & Yu-corrected Tunisian OR -> RR. Subjected to full PSA.

definition: Relative Risk of emigration under Scenario 2 infrastructure reform vs status quo
mathematical_role: Multiplicative modifier to emigration probability
source: Derived from beta_infra_relative DCE weight and Tunisian working conditions OR (Zhang & Yu corrected)
study_design: Derived from DCE meta-analysis + survey OR bounds
justification: Same derivation chain as RR_wage_scen1 but for infrastructure/workplace attribute. NOT directly observed.

definition: Relative Risk of emigration under Scenario 3 rural incentive package vs status quo
mathematical_role: Multiplicative modifier to interior-region emigration probability
source: Derived from beta_rural_relative DCE weight and rural/hardship allowance magnitude
justification: No Tunisia-specific rural retention evaluation exists. Derived from DCE meta-analytic rural incentive weights.

definition: Proportional increase in medical school intake and residency quota under Scenario 4
mathematical_role: Modifies graduate inflow vector: G_scen4 = G_baseline * (1 + expansion_factor)
source: Government announcement of 30% intake increase in 2025; MESRS JORT decrees
justification: Scenario assumption grounded in the Tunisian government's 2025 announcement of 30% intake expansion. Upper bound (+50%) tests ambitious expansion; lower bound (+20%) tests conservative implementation.

definition: Fraction of expanded-intake graduates retained via return-of-service commitment during contract period
mathematical_role: Modifies effective retention for Scenario 4 contractual obligations
source: Barnighausen & Bloom (2009) DOI:10.1186/1472-6963-9-86; Frehywot et al. (2010) DOI:10.2471/BLT.09.070607
justification: International systematic review evidence shows 65-85% retention during contract fulfilment. No Tunisian-specific return-of-service program evaluation exists. Post-contract retention is uncertain and tested separately.

definition: Composite Relative Risk of emigration under comprehensive reform package (Scenario 5)
mathematical_role: Multiplicative composite: RR_package = RR_wage * RR_infra * RR_rural
source: Multiplicative bounding protocol as mandated in PROJECT_SPEC.md Section 15
justification: Computed as product of individual component RRs: RR_package = prod(RR_k). This guarantees diminishing marginal returns and prevents probability bound violations. NOT independently estimated.

definition: Observed CNOM Good Standing certificates issued in 2020
mathematical_role: Calibration target for observation equation
source: CNOM Annual Report (SRC_CNOM_ANN)
justification: Directly reported by CNOM. COVID-19 border closure year; represents temporary suppression of departure flow.

definition: Observed CNOM Good Standing certificates issued in 2021
mathematical_role: Calibration target
source: CNOM Annual Report (SRC_CNOM_ANN)
justification: Directly reported by CNOM. Start of post-COVID departure acceleration.

definition: Observed CNOM Good Standing certificates issued in 2024
mathematical_role: Calibration/validation target
source: CNOM Annual Report (SRC_CNOM_ANN)
justification: Directly reported by CNOM. Latest available data point.

definition: Cumulative CNOM certificates 2021-2024
mathematical_role: Aggregate calibration constraint
source: CNOM Annual Report cumulative statement
justification: Aggregate officially reported by CNOM as approximately 6000 between 2021-2024.
